user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends from Los Angeles to San Francisco next month and we want to have an amazing playlist for the journey. Can you suggest some popular songs from the '80s that we can add to our playlist? Also, could you recommend some similar songs to 'Sweet Child O' Mine' by Guns N' Roses?

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of popular songs from the 1980s.
Find songs similar to 'Sweet Child O' Mine' by Guns N' Roses.
Combine the results from Step 1 and Step 2 into a single playlist.
